mechanism_narrative: ERBB2 (RTK) and IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor) are forced into close proximity by a flexible GS4 linker (~20 Å). ERBB2's kinase transphosphorylates IL6ST's cytoplasmic tail, enhancing JAK/STAT3 signaling, while JAKs bound to IL6ST reciprocally phosphorylate ERBB2's C-terminal tyrosines, boosting GRB2-SHC1-GAB1-PIK3R1 recruitment and downstream MAPK/AKT signaling. PLCγ1 is sterically excluded by the constrained geometry. The biased output shifts aged muscle toward a young transcriptional phenotype: muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) are upregulated via SRF/MRTF and MAPK, while aged markers and stress-response IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP) are suppressed via AKT-mediated FOXO exclusion and reduced inflammatory signaling.
